expressions.cn: 数字化转型 (shùzìhuà zhuǎnxíng) / 数字化 (shùzìhuà)
优化流程 (yōuhuà liúchéng) / 效率 (xiàolǜ)
数据分析 (shùjù fēnxī) / 分析数据 (fēnxī shùjù)
用户友好 (yònghù yǒuhǎo) / 直观 (zhíguān)

work.scenario: During a project planning meeting, your manager emphasizes the need for a more efficient workflow.
key_phrases: Kita perlu **menyelaraskan proses** kerja untuk meningkatkan **kecekapan**.
We need to **streamline our work processes** to boost **efficiency**.
我们需要**优化流程**以提高**效率**。

life.scenario: You're discussing the government's recent efforts to make public services more accessible online.
key_phrases: Sekarang banyak perkhidmatan kerajaan dah **tukar digital**, lagi **senang guna**.
Many government services have now **digitalized**, making them more **user-friendly**.
现在很多政府服务都**数字化**了，更**用户友好**。

tech.scenario: A startup founder is explaining their new AI-driven product to potential investors.
key_phrases: Kami sedang **membangunkan** satu platform yang boleh melakukan **analisis data** dengan pantas. Ia direka agar sangat **intuitif**.
We are **developing** a platform that can perform rapid **data analysis**. It's designed to be very **intuitive**.
我们正在**开发**一个可以快速进行**数据分析**的平台。它被设计得非常**直观**。
